create table expense_tracker.users ( id_pk bigint not null, created timestamp(6), deleted timestamp(6), updated timestamp(6), mobile varchar(11) not null, name varchar(50) not null, password varchar(300) not null, verified boolean default false, primary key (id_pk) );
create sequence expense_tracker.users_sequence start with 1 increment by 50;
